messages:
ana: quick heads-up — I'm doing a smokewalk on the zephyr-7b conversion (safetensors + tp layout). looking for: where raw checkpoints live, any known tokenizer quirks, and recommended tp split.

mike: raw checkpoints are in s3://redwood-raw-models/zephyr/7b/v1/ — there's a README.txt in that prefix. use the hash in manifest.json for verification.

sophia: tokenizer note: the model's vocab has two special duplicate tokens for <|pad|> depending on the conversion tool. when we ran earlier, token id 0 and id 50256 both mapped to <|pad|>. watch for that during tokenizer.json merge.

ana: @sophia that's the exact thing I hit. Fix was to dedupe by string and keep the lowest id, then remap embeddings. add to checklist. :white_check_mark:

lucas: for TP layout, ops were compiled for tp=2 originally. if we convert to tp=4 we need remap of shard filenames and the checkpoint index. prefer keeping tp=2 to avoid recompiling kernels.

mike: agree. stick to tp=2 for first release. we can provide tp=4 later if perf team requests.

ana: conversion command I'm using (sharing so others can reproduce):
```bash
python convert_checkpoint.py --input s3://redwood-raw-models/zephyr/7b/v1/ckpt-000 --output s3://redwood-onboarded/zephyr-7b/safetensors/ --format safetensors --tp 2 --dtype fp16 --manifest manifests/zephyr-7b-manifest.json
```

sophia: include `--tokenizer-fix dedupe` flag, otherwise the tokenizer step will fail on our validator. also add `--skip-optim` if you want a quick smokewalk without quantization.

ana: ran validator, got two warnings: checksum mismatch for shard_000 and unexpected key name "lm_head.weight" in state_dict. dump below: 
```
Validator: warning shard_000 checksum mismatch (expected 6a1f, got 6a1e)
Validator: info extraneous key lm_head.weight ignored for encoder-only layout
```

mike: checksum off by one nibble usually means metadata changed during upload. re-upload shard_000 with `aws s3 cp --acl bucket-owner-full-control` and re-run validator. for lm_head msg, we usually rename to `output_head.weight` in the manifest mapping.

ana: re-uploaded shard_000, checksum now matches. re-run shows one remaining: tokenizer mapping conflict at ids [0,50256]. planning to run dedupe and remap.

sophia: when remapping embeddings, remember to update the `vocab_size` field in model_config.json if we drop duplicates. otherwise serving runtime index lookup will OOB.

lucas: also add a `tp_layout.json` alongside the shards that lists how tensors are sharded, and a small compatibility hint: "tp=2 canonical for zephyr-7b". runtime will read that to avoid accidental auto-reshard.

ana: PR opened: https://git.redwood.internal/zephyr/packaging/pulls/42 — includes convert script, dedupe tokenizer step, and tp_layout.json. ping me for review.

mike: quick CR done, left two nits about logging. one more ask: add a short smoke test that loads the safetensors bundle + tokenizer and runs generate for 8 tokens. we run that in CI on dedicated infra.

ana: adding smoke test now; I'll run on a small GPU in staging and post logs.

deploy-bot: CI started for pr/42 — job: zephyr-packaging-smoke (gpu-small).

ana: CI passed the smoke test (logs: "generated tokens OK, latency 45ms"). moving to onboard bucket: s3://redwood-onboarded/zephyr-7b/release-candidate/

sophia: great. final checklist for release-candidate: 1) safetensors present for all shards, 2) tp_layout.json, 3) tokenizer deduped and model_config.json updated, 4) manifest hash verified, 5) smoke test pass.

lucas: I'll schedule a short rollout window tomorrow to pin this on dedicated infra (tp=2 nodes).

ana: thanks all — filing a short handoff note in the model registry now. if anyone hits regressions, ping here. :rocket:
